notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

It has been a bit since I’ve had the unfortunate and undesirable moment to talk with you. Yes, I liked it better when you were trapped in my crypts, screaming trying to get out. The good news is: there will be more of that in the future! My dungeon will be getting an expansion. My developer minions have been toiling their poor souls to death trying to get me to free them. 

They have updated and expanded on the irresistible card game of Whatever, in which I am undefeated. Anyone that tells you otherwise is lying and will be dealt with promptly. Now, my thrall will explain how to play and what is new in the taverns.

[previewyoutube=476Z1kBUp5A;full][/previewyoutube]

[quote]Hello, it is the Cryptmaster's favorite minion! One day they will remember my name!

Whatever, as some of you may know, is the premiere card-word game down in the underworld. Please don’t tell the people in the overworld or they might try to monetize it and turn it into loot boxes or throw a battlepass on there. They can get very scary up there.

Anywho, throughout your adventures you can challenge people to a game of Whatever by asking them “Whatever.” Only the lowest life would refuse to play against you.

Once you draw your letter tabs, you will also draw cards that have powerful effects to help you win the game. Before you start the game you can swap tabs or cards that you have drawn to gain a better start.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/95276d0a00edc11b3fe789c664d404e3519914cb.jpg[/img]

After you begin, you will start first. Player luck or something. You and your opponent will start with 40 life and your goal is to eliminate their life before they have a chance to terminate yours. You’ll deal damage with cards by selecting two letter tabs to play at a time, trying to match letters to the names of the cards in your hand. In addition to the effect of the card itself, each letter you match deals 1 damage. Once you play your letter tabs your turn ends. Your turn will start again once the opponent's turn completes. 

The cards in your deck are very important. If you spell the words on the card they may unleash powerful effects! They can range from healing, dealing damage, increasing hand size, and more. That effect will play after your letter damage and you will draw a new card. In between matches, you will gain new cards to play with, especially by winning games of Whatever. In between games, you can set up your deck and choose the cards you want to play. What deck will you build?

You may have noticed the black letter tabs in the screenshot. The black tabs are wild letters that will change letters every turn. White tabs won’t change letters. Wild letters can help you seal the deal! Especially when they change into something powerful for you!

If you only have terrible tabs and there is no good play, then you can use your turn to turn in all your letters and draw all new tabs. You won’t do any damage and won’t gain progress on your cards but you could set up for a powerful play your next turn.

[h2]Anniversary Update[/h2]
The wonderful, infallible Cryptmaster ordered us to expand on the perfect crypts and so, we’ll be featuring plenty of new gameplay to dig into. They deserve all the credit. Don’t listen to the developers trying to take their credit.

New NPCs to meet! Yes! Yes! They are friendly, I promise! They just want to play Whatever! The Highwayman & The Innkeeper! Go meet them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/ae8f1e16829592e0043877a9834727c8728923f9.jpg[/img]

Downwood also got an expansion. There are rumors of a new graveyard in Downwood as… I’m too scared of the paranormal to look! Please don’t make me go! The Tavern where you can play in Whatever tournaments against new players. Defeat them all and gain new cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/e4fff50fba84a0783a192aa3d95ccee9c5eebf8e.jpg[/img]

Speaking of new cards, this update adds a few new cards. 10? No. 20? Think higher! 50? Higher! Over 100 new cards! So many new cards! New combos and strategies to develop! Don’t drop them! It might take a while to clean them up.

If Whatever just wasn’t your cup of whatever you drink, then there are a few other things that might be enticing to check out. There is a new enemy to find. The Piskies. I personally stay away from them as they are too dangerous for a lower minion like me to fight so I don’t have much information on them but I’m sure strong heroes like you will do fine!

There is a new world map feature in the dungeon! If you press “5” the map will expand to show you what area you are in on the map! Very helpful in figuring out where you may need to go! I suggested “You are Here” signs throughout the dungeon but the Cryptmaster knows best!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/f810594da4331006c760878cdfecb9a17afab790.jpg[/img]

Some other important feature that the Crypmaster blessed us with is that the crypts now have 7k support and a new auto color option! This will change the color tints based on the location you are in!

That is all I have for now! Be sure to check out the new stuff![/quote]

Thank you for keeping that minion busy. If I had a brain he would have given me a headache many years ago. For keeping him distracted and giving me a few minutes of peace and quiet, I am pushing this update now and for free! See, I can be nice sometimes. Hahaha...

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Cryptmaster Steam Trading Cards Now Available
notes.content:
Hey Doomed Souls,

My minions have finally gotten through the Valve gates and [i]Cryptmaster[/i] Steam trading cards, badges, backdrops, emoticons and more are now available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/38431800329d11ee2df0deb4dc109afa56e5f71e.png[/img]

They work so hard for me. If you have been adventuring through my dungeon then you may already have these special cards in your inventory. These cards are not legally rated for Whatever. Trying to play Whatever with these cards will result in an immediate game loss and the title of ‘I am a cheater’. 

Please don’t test me. There are five Steam trading cards to collect.

Also my developer minions have updated the artbook which is now available. If you already purchased, you get this update for free lucky souls!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2952160/Cryptmaster_Artbook/

notes.title: Cryptmaster shoulder rider reveal
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

[b]My marketing minions have done a disservice to me and partnered with Youtooz to turn me into a marketable shoulder rider plushie which is releasing on December 6th.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718540/d55be083bea6eb7b9ab249a9b546f1db8dece386.gif[/img]

How dare they! I will send them to the barrier to disintegrate them myself for doing that to me. I am that master of the underworld meant to be scary and to be feared. To guide clueless souls through my dungeon, not some cute guide to sit on your shoulder. Apparently my minions said that they believe it will increase your spelling capabilities once you put them on. Can you believe that?

Here is the link if you are soooo curious.
https://youtooz.com/products/cryptmaster-shoulder-rider-6-inch


I won’t smite you for getting these on December 6th, but I will look at you disapprovingly like I always have while guiding you through my crypts.

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: Patch notes v1.04.1
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

I’m sorry about the sounds of construction in the crypts while working on this patch. Of course you don’t have ears, they rotted away many decades ago heheh. This patch includes Steamdeck specific fixes to the joypad system, options toggle to disable eating sounds, new procedural text system for joypad input and more. 

[h3][b]Full Patch Notes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New predictive text system for joypad input, expanding the virtual joypad to auto detect skills, words and alike to make for much easier word entry, contextual based on situation.
[*] Steamdeck specific fixes to the joypad system, including fixing input lag and improvements to virtual joypad navigation.
[*] Removal of the old predictive system (sorry speedrunners!) as it conflicts with the new predictive joypad system, this will be further revised in the next update.
[*] Spanish rare fish names are not correctly named.
[*] More fixes to Iss's scroll to make it a little bit more easy.
[*] Options toggle to disable eating sounds.
[*] Ratty's node on the map is obscured has been fixed.
[*] Steamdeck support for upscaling minimap text to be more readable.
[*] fixing the Goggo achievement to allow 100% completion.
[*] 5120x1440 ultrawide support.
[/list]
Also we are less than 50 reviews to 1,000 reviews on Steam with an overwhelming positive rating! Thank you for the amazing support for the best crypts on Steam!

- The Cryptmaster

notes.title: The Crypts 1.034 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

It seems that some of you have discovered some bugs in my perfect crypts– and not the kind whose soul you slurp up. I would like personally to apologize to those who had to listen to Finks laugh and not being able to skip it, attacks not doing the correct damage, and a few more issues the visitors have found. My goal is to make the crypts as welcoming as possible so that more souls can become trapped and try to escape. I will personally take away a few letters from my minions. 

Before I finish, [i]Cryptmaster[/i] has almost 500 reviews on Steam with a 96% positive rating. If we keep above 95% at 500 reviews, my unholy crusade will be upgraded to “overwhelmingly positive” on Steam so if you have some time, please leave us a review.
 
[h3]Now back to the patch notes, here is the full notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional looting "Fingers" on enemies' letters accessibility toggle for quicker skill unlocks.
[*] Reducing the difficulty on god scrolls
[*] Stopped Vitus rap looping from the start when you want to enter something else.
[*] Disable screenshake option in menu
[*] Tomb kings hold subtitles added, so the subtitles don't fade away.
[*] Additional fishing tooltips on first cast
[*] To palace to change to palace/swamps, and or generally better swamp markers.
[*] Gel cube area named as location, removing a bit of swamp confusion
[*] Lorias door still glitches out sometimes, will rebuild that script.
[*] Swamps altar, between the palace and the pools to add another save point
[*] Add block minimap rotation option in options
[*] Ratty respawning even if quest is complete
[*] Temple audio upgrades on the speaker system.
[*] [spoiler]Embezzle[/spoiler] - deal 1 damage when it mentions 2 damage
[*] [spoiler]Dogwhistle[/spoiler] - damage fixed.
[*] Goggos script dead ends and blocks progress after you revisit him post Pantry.
[*] Bump zombie names at top of tower, increasing difficulty slightly.
[*] [spoiler]N and M[/spoiler] skulls are too close together, they will be moving further apart.
[*] Add controller real-time slowdown, so real-time is a bit more forgiving on controller.
[*] The icon on the map where you entered so that you can see your map entry point.
[*] New level-up music and world music.
[*] Self-damage in cards plays wrong sound effects
[*] Rare fish are a bit too skittish right now
[*] Finks laughs variation, also fix it so it is skippable.
[*] Double [spoiler]Darkness[/spoiler] skull in the Bonehouses
[*] Highlight on whatever on start sometimes missing
[*] Removed RNG on shields + armor combinations so you cant get damage locked.
[*] Slow down [spoiler]murder/drums[/spoiler] cooldown, so you can preempt those out of combat.
[*] [spoiler]Urchins[/spoiler] gets buffed to 4 projectiles.
[*] Fish highlighting white between maps
[*] Library east wing/right labels
[*] Iss shader toned back
[*] Remove line breaking on danger letters entirely, so that it doesn't break on Iss's island.
[*] Eyestone card is bugged, will be renamed to "Eye" also.
[*] Pipers final rap has wrong lines on final/repeat version.
[*] Joros self damage abilities will be buffed to allow for more variety in his use.
[*] Payns boulders not activating if you go the long way.
[*] Moving one of the dead paladins in the downwood to a more central location, making a generic mob you get the helmet from, the other will be either a dead body, or a mob, depending on which you kill first, this will lead into the update beyond 1.034....
[*] Spanish news puzzle has been correctly realigned on the levels to represent N O S E instead of N O E S
[*] Riddle04 despawning bug fixed.
[*] Fixed combat lock when fighting gel cubes in the swamps
[/list]

If you want to check out the change logs for the next patch, one of my developer minions have started a post here so you can view what is coming next.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1885110/discussions/0/4337608365463568669/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Cryptmaster Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

The developers of [b]Cryptmaster[/b], Lee Williams and Paul Hart appeared to have escaped my crypts and have said that they would only continue working in my tomb only if they were allowed to speak about what is going on in a dev log. I reluctantly agreed to their terms so here is Lee and Paul to answer a few questions.

Keep your boney eyes peeled…Tomorrow I have a special video coming out to showcase some more of the wastelands around my crypts.

[h2]Dev log[/h2]
[h3]What was your inspiration for Cryptmaster?[/h3]

[b]Cryptmaster[/b] is the result of a whole jumble of inspirations, many of which only became apparent as we were making it. Mechanically, there are touches of classic dungeon crawlers, puzzle games, word-based games like Scribblenauts and RPGs. In theme and aesthetic, we drew from a lot of the passions of our younger selves, things which are now kind of nostalgic: D&D, Fighting Fantasy, B-movies, board games…

Two key influences were the VHS board game Atmosfear and the TV show Knightmare. We were fortunate enough to get Hugo Myatt, who presented the latter, to provide some voice-over for the game!

[h3]Any funny bugs you would like to share?[/h3]

There have been heaps. Endlessly spawning crabs, over-enthusiastic ragdolling, unsolvable puzzles. Some of them even stayed in the game, like the [i]Cryptmaster's [/i]tendency to keep trying to look at the thing he's holding while he's talking to you.

[h3]What has been your favorite moment(s) in developing Cryptmaster so far?[/h3]

The whole process has been a lot of fun. Just coming up with crazy ideas and seeing what sticks. That's the joy of a small team really. Hopefully some of that joy and playfulness will be transmitted to the players.

[h3]What are some tips you can give to people looking to design games?[/h3]

Just go for it. Start making games, joining game jams, getting to know how things work. Embrace failure and you'll always be learning.

[h3]What is something you have learned in developing Cryptmaster?[/h3]

The whole thing has been a learning process. There are things we'd do differently if we were to make it again but then we wouldn't have the game we have now, so maybe that's a good thing!

[h3]Is there a “secret word” that players should say to the Cryptmaster when they play the demo?[/h3]

The [i]Cryptmaster [/i]is a keen player of ROCK, PAPER, SCISSORS. He can also be persuaded to indulge in a spot of ASMR. Really, I'd encourage players to experiment - we have a LOT of responses in there!

If you would like to try your luck on my crypts, the demo is available right now for you to try. heheheh

notes.title: Cryptmaster Steam Next Fest Schedule
notes.content:
Hey doomed souls,

One of my, shall we say colleagues, mentioned this little thing called Steam Next Fest. My minions of the crypts have been getting lazy. I watched one of them just give a soul the letters instead of fighting them, so I think a fresh, new wave of “visitors” to the crypts would shape up my minions.

I set aside a few souls to help schedule what to do for Steam Next Fest. I, of course, came up with all the ideas. If this fails though, those poor, unfortunate souls are going to wish all they had to do was go through the crypts.

[h3]Monday - Play the demo[/h3]
Those curious who happen to wander into my crypts will struggle against the waves of minions I have set aside. The demo is available to check out and try your luck in these dank dungeons.

[h3]Tuesday - Dev Log[/h3]
The foolish developers who set me loose on all of you, Paul and Lee, want to talk about how development has been proceeding, as well as share some funny bugs and what inspired the creation of Cryptmaster. Trivial but I suppose they are allowed their trivialities.

[h3]Wednesday - Cryptmaster Video[/h3]
Luckily, not all of my minions are so thoroughly useless. I’ve had a number of them work on something I’m told is called a “trailer,” showing you the desolate wastelands you’ll be traveling through. This will be released on Wednesday so be sure to “look” on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@AkuparaGames]Akupara Youtube[/url].

[h3]Thursday: D&D Cryptmaster stream (10am PST)[/h3]
A few souls have approached me regarding something called “Dungeons and Dragons.” I am reliably informed it will give me entirely new avenues to torture the risen dead under my thrall, so I have decided to showcase their public humiliation to all of you.

You can watch on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885110/Cryptmaster/]Cryptmaster Steam page[/url] at 10am PST.

[h3]Friday: Gameplay stream (10am PST)[/h3]
Finally, one of my minions will go deeper in the crypts themself. It will be the first time any of you will be able to see the game past the demo and I will be watching and making improvements if they survive. It would be boring if they didn’t at least suffer a little.

- Cryptmaster

notes.title: Journey into Cryptmaster, a dungeon-crawling RPG published by Akupara Games!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Crypt!

Today, I’m happy to announce that Akupara Games will publish developers Paul Hart and Lee Williams’ upcoming dungeon-crawling adventure game, [i]Cryptmaster[/i]. A darkly comedic adventure through a sprawling underworld, you’ll need to find clever solutions to intricate problems if you want to escape. Think outside the box to outsmart enemies, progress through obstacles, and solve the mystery at the heart of your own damnation!

[previewyoutube=V5gPsb4urRc;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Cryptmaster[/i] is a narrative adventure with a nostalgic visual style about a party of recently awakened dead heroes. An eccentric figure, known only as the Cryptmaster, tasks you to journey upwards through the strata of fantastic underground kingdoms. Along the way meet a myriad of quirky characters, find cryptic puzzles, and combat classic enemies all by typing out your actions!

Wishlist Cryptmaster here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885110/Cryptmaster

An irreverent, quick-talking adventure, [i]Cryptmaster[/i] arms players with the freedom of exploration and approach to every situation. Everything from responding in conversation all the way to attacking a skeleton is triggered by the player typing how they would like to respond. Journey your way through the underground using your words and your wit!

We’ll be featuring [i]Cryptmaster[/i] here and there over the course of the next few months, so make sure you have an eye out for updates on [url=https://twitter.com/akuparagames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/akuparagames]Discord![/url]

[b]Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Say Anything You Want[/b] - Interact with the world and conquer quests by typing or speaking any word you can think of - each encounter has multiple solutions to discover!
[*] [b]A Weird, Wild World[/b] - Travel through mysterious underground kingdoms and meet talking doors, flirtatious toads, sarcastic ghouls, and more.
[*] [b]Noun You're Playing With Power[/b] - Dungeon battles are fueled by words - decipher forgotten spells, then type their names in battle to unleash the might of your undead heroes.
